✨ First Impression

"My first impression is an aesthetically pleasing color palette with very harmonious tones, combined with a somewhat basic or unstructured composition. I also notice excellent edge definition and high sharpness details that anchor the subject nicely."

⚙ Suggested Edits

  • ✔ Apply minor contrast adjustments to enhance depth.
  • ✔ Add a subtle post-crop vignette (-5 to -10).
  • ✔ Use HSL adjustments to slightly shift greens toward teal or warm up yellows.
  • ✔ Decrease temperature slider by -5 to -10, or adjust the tint slightly toward green/magenta.
  • ✔ Apply a masking slider to sharpening so it only affects high-contrast edges, leaving flat areas smooth.
  • ✔ Boost whites by +5 for extra sparkle.
  • ✔ Slightly drop black levels by -3 to add a solid anchor.
  • ✔ Keep ambient details high while vignetting slightly.
  • ✔ Slightly desaturate non-essential colors to make the main color pop.
  • ✔ Crop slightly to shift subject placement closer to a thirds grid line.
